title: [Verification] Instrument-backed measurements: PPS against an external reference, and the PHY-boundary timestamp split and window

milestone.title: Instrument verification (2027)
milestone.description: Measurements that need an external instrument on the bench: an oscilloscope with a 1 PPS reference, and a PHY-boundary timestamp instrument. Everything that can be proven in simulation or from the fabric's own counters stays in the 2026 milestones.

body:
[A10] Owner decision, 2026-09-20: the verifications that need an external instrument are gathered in ONE ticket under a next-year milestone, so they stop sitting in the 2026 queues as "blocked on the bench".

## What is gathered here

| Measurement | Instrument | Detail and acceptance live in |
|---|---|---|
| The PPS edge and its 1e9 ns period against an external reference, over at least 10 pulses, from a build with the PPS parameter on (J11 pin 35, FPGA pin C17, LVCMOS33, ground on J11 pin 37) | oscilloscope, a 1 PPS reference (GPS receiver or the peer) | #260, acceptance 3 (the code merged with pull request 457 and is verified in simulation) |
| The gPTP ingress and egress timestamp latency as two numbers, not only their sum, per board | a PHY-boundary timestamp instrument (tap or analyser with hardware timestamps at the MDI), topology recorded before measuring | #64, work items 1 to 4 and acceptance 1 and 2 |
| The real egress-timestamp window the gPTP plane exposes on hardware, correlated with the wire | the same PHY-boundary instrument for the wire side; the fabric's own counters for the internal side | #213, measurements and acceptance 2 to 5 |

## Acceptance

1. The instrument, its calibration state, the topology and the tool revisions are recorded BEFORE the first measurement (`docs/findings/`).
2. Each row above is measured on the exact shipping image of its day, with raw captures kept, and its owning issue's acceptance boxes are ticked or closed with the numbers.
3. The measured constants land where #64 says they must (one layer owns the correction; the other carries zeros), and `docs/testing` and the compliance matrix quote the measured values with their uncertainty.

## Not in this ticket

Anything provable without an instrument stays where it is: the fabric-counter half of #213, the ownership rule of #64 item 5, and the simulation proofs of #260 are 2026 work. The two-board silicon validation (#117) and the gPTP admission failure (#358) use the controller host and the reference peer, not these instruments.
